licence.renewalWindow.value: Renew before the current term expires. No earlier window is stated in an official source.
licence.renewalWindow.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Sharjah Media City (Shams), renewal window (Shams Companies and Licensing Regulations 2017 art. 12.1, CONFIRMED. Advice, not a rule: consultancies suggest starting 30 to 45 days before expiry); https://www.shams.ae/hubfs/Regulations%2020250429/Regulations/Shams%20Companies%20and%20Licensing%20Regulations%202017.pdf?hsLang=ar ; https://nowconsultant.com/shams-license-renewal/

licence.renewsTogether.value: Visa allocations must be renewed together with the business licence at licence renewal. Lease or flexi desk renewal: unknown from an official source.
licence.renewsTogether.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Sharjah Media City (Shams), renews together (official terms on shamsfz.ae, which shams.ae links to, CONFIRMED); https://shamsfz.ae/terms-and-conditions/ ; https://www.shams.ae/

licence.afterExpiry.value: A 30 day grace period from licence expiry, then a monthly late penalty accrues until the licence is renewed or cancelled. The Authority may issue a legal notice 6 months after expiry, suspend the company 7 months after expiry, and cancel the immigration card and visas. The Authority may also suspend or cancel for unpaid renewal fees, with written notice.
licence.afterExpiry.source: Boasis research, free zone licence renewal (2026-09-28), Sharjah Media City (Shams), late renewal (official terms on shamsfz.ae and Companies and Licensing Regulations 2017 art. 13.2, CONFIRMED; amounts left out); https://shamsfz.ae/terms-and-conditions/ ; https://www.shams.ae/hubfs/Regulations%2020250429/Regulations/Shams%20Companies%20and%20Licensing%20Regulations%202017.pdf?hsLang=ar
